name: CapView
summary:
CapView – Effortless Video Capture & Preview on Meta Quest

CapView transforms your Meta Quest headset into a portable video display, allowing you to preview and capture video input in real-time. Simply connect a UVC capture card, and instantly expand your viewing experience. Whether you’re extending your gaming screen, monitoring a camera feed, or showcasing educational content, CapView brings seamless video display to your VR headset.

**Try CapView for free today and enhance your visual workflow in VR!**
